'''2007 Texas State Championship Gabe Taylor LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Gabe Taylor]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Lame Senate
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
